requirement.statement: Implements `PDPP-Version` header negotiation.

cases.assertion: An unsupported PDPP-Version header is rejected with 400 unsupported_version.
A token bound to a grant whose schema major version is unsupported is rejected with 400 unsupported_version, while a grant at the supported version still reads.
cases.detail: The adapter has no grantWithSchemaVersion hook and supportedGrantSchemaVersion, so no token can be bound to a grant at a chosen schema version and the grant-schema axis is unobservable. The suite will not forge a grant body: the obligation is on the RS's handling of a grant its own AS issued, and a suite-authored artifact would test the suite's idea of the grant schema.

requirement.statement: Scopes owner token access to a single subject's data store, deriving `subject_id` from the introspection response.

cases.assertion: An owner token for another subject cannot read the seeded subject's records.

requirement.statement: SHOULD support owner-authenticated access to the record query endpoints without a client grant (self-export).

cases.assertion: An owner token reads the owner's own records through the client query endpoints without a client grant.

requirement.statement: For owner-token stream-metadata reads, returns the full current stream metadata within the owner's scope, including current query, view, and relationship capabilities.

cases.assertion: An owner-token stream-metadata read returns the full current schema and declared query/view/relationship capabilities, not a grant-projected subset.

requirement.statement: For client-token stream-metadata reads, returns only a projection derived from the resolved authorization context, excluding current view/relationship/filter/expansion/aggregation capability and any post-issuance declaration change.

cases.assertion: Client-token stream metadata exposes only granted fields and omits current view/relationship/query capability.

requirement.statement: Publishes RFC 9728 protected resource metadata at the RFC 9728 Section 3 location carrying `resource` and the four `pdpp_` members, and returns a `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` challenge with `resource_metadata` on 401.

cases.assertion: A record read with no access token is refused with 401 rather than served.
